about: Lumbridge Swamp's quest NPCs (Misthalin piece 7 step 1): Abigale and Hewey in the south-east corner, and Sergeants Mossfists and Slimetoes by the swamp caves' entrance. Each is the 242 cache's multi-NPC, which picks what it shows from its quest's progress; every account has done every quest, and after them none of the four shows (the multi-NPCs' lists and the quests' end states, osrs-dumps and the 242 cache, read 2026-11-09). They are spawned anyway, hidden, as live has them there: a RuneLite plugin sees the multi-NPC. Tiles are mejrs's live NPC list (from players part way through the quests); they stand still (wander 0, guessed).

spawns.source: Abigale, the south-east corner of the swamp; mejrs sees her at this tile. The 242 cache shows her as Abigale (7623) while mistmyst_progress (varbit 3468) is 0 to 15, and as nothing after: Misthalin Mystery ends at 135, so hidden. mejrs data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json; osrs-dumps dump.npc and dump.dbrow

Hewey (size 2), beside Abigale; mejrs sees him at this tile. Shown as Hewey (7624) for mistmyst_progress 0 to 15 only, so hidden after Misthalin Mystery. mejrs data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json; osrs-dumps dump.npc and dump.dbrow

Sergeant Mossfists, by the swamp caves' entrance; mejrs sees him at this tile. The 242 cache shows him (5161) while slice_quest (varbit 3550) is 8 or 9, and as nothing after: Another Slice of H.A.M. ends at 11, so hidden. mejrs data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json; osrs-dumps dump.npc and dump.dbrow
